Ola Electric Mobility reported a consolidated net loss of ₹362 crore for the July–September quarter (Q2FY27), narrowing from ₹418 crore a year ago, while its revenue declined by 39% year-on-year to ₹421 crore, triggering a over 6% drop in its share price on November 13.
